name: Pipes Carrying Water From Source To Field
benefit: **Financial Assistance:** Subsidy on 50% cost or ₹15,000/- for water carrying pipes upto 800m and all types of pipes(PVC HDPE etc.,) and all sizes as per the requirement of the farmer.
_eligibility_text:
- The beneficiary should be a Farmer.
- The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
